workflow.name: Plan, then execute
workflow.description: A planner breaks a goal into up to six agent stages; the engine validates the plan and runs it, then a report summarises what each stage did.

prompts.label: plan
prompts.text:
Goal: {{variables.goal}}
Read the code first, then plan how to reach the goal as a few independent or ordered steps. Each step is a stage run by its own agent in this workspace: give it a short key, a name and a precise, self-contained prompt that names the files to change, the existing helpers to follow, the exact test and lint commands to run, and what done looks like; mark read-only steps readOnly. Steps that edit the same files must be ordered, not parallel. End with a review step that depends on every other step: it reads the whole diff, checks the goal's acceptance criteria and the edge cases a careful reviewer would raise (invalid input, security, limits), fixes what it finds and runs every affected test and lint. Add an edge from a step to every step that needs its result; steps without edges between them run in parallel, each in its own copy of the code that merges back when it finishes, so a step never sees a parallel step's changes.

prompts.label: report
